name: Bi1−xSbx alloy
topology: First experimentally observed 3D topological insulator (0.07 < x < 0.22)
summary: For intermediate Sb content the L-point bands invert and a small bulk gap opens. Proposed by Fu and Kane and observed by Hsieh et al. Bi–Sb alloys are also among the best n-type thermoelectrics below ~200 K.
